description: What a deployment of this application must honour. Owned here and kept exact by tests in this repository; deployment tooling tests its own configuration against it. player_edge_public_file_paths: GET routes under the player API that serve a file without a session, so an can fetch them; an edge proxy in front of the player must let these paths through to the app instead of answering them itself. obs_service_env: the environment variable names the obs service in compose/docker-compose.player-public.yml passes into the container; a variable the deployment renders but the service does not list never reaches the process.
